'''Decipher expansion names''' records working titles, renamed sets, and cancelled expansions for Star Wars CCG as they appeared in ''[[The Duelist]]'' and later Decipher announcements.

== 1996–1998 names ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! First printed name !! Later name !! Source
|-
| ''The Empire Strikes Back'' || [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] || ''The Duelist'' #9 (February 1996) named the second expansion ''The Empire Strikes Back'', due in October.<ref name="duelist9col" /> Issue 13 named it ''The Empire Strikes Back: Hoth'', first of three 162-card sets based on the second movie.<ref name="duelist13news" />
|-
| ''Shadows of the Empire'' (1996–97) || cancelled || Issue 13 dated the set to late December or January.<ref name="duelist13news" /> Issue 14 said its future was uncertain and that some cards planned for ''Shadows'' would appear in ''[[Special Edition]]'' (projected for June 1997).<ref name="duelist14news" /> Issue 15 reported that plans for a ''Shadows of the Empire'' expansion had been canceled.<ref name="duelist15news" />
|-
| ''Bespin'' || [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] || Issue 14 listed ''Bespin'' for the following October after ''[[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]]'' in February.<ref name="duelist14news" /> Issue 20 described ''Cloud City'' as the last third of ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref name="duelist20news" />
|-
| ''Return of the Jedi: Tatooine'' / ''Tatooine'' || [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] || Issue 14 listed three ''Return of the Jedi'' expansions (''Tatooine'', ''Endor'', and ''Death Star'') for February, June, and October 1998.<ref name="duelist14news" /> Issue 20 said ''Return of the Jedi: Tatooine'' would appear in spring.<ref name="duelist20news" /> Issues 21 and 23 named ''Jabba's Palace'' (formerly ''Tatooine'') as the first of three 165-card ''Return of the Jedi'' sets.<ref name="duelist21news" /><ref name="duelist23news" />
|-
| ''Death Star'' (1998 ROTJ slot) || [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] || Issue 14 listed ''Death Star'' as the third 1998 ''Return of the Jedi'' expansion.<ref name="duelist14news" /> The published set is [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]].
|-
| ''Endor'' || [[Endor Limited|Endor]] || Named with ''Tatooine'' and ''Death Star'' in issue 14, and again for year's end in issue 23.<ref name="duelist14news" /><ref name="duelist23news" />
|}

== 2000–2001 cancelled sets ==

After [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]], Decipher announced a second [[Shadows of the Empire]] product (~20 cards, August 2000) plus [[Skywalkers (expansion)|Skywalkers]], [[Jedi Masters]], [[Scoundrels]], and [[Reflections Gold]]. Those sets are listed on [[Cancelled Expansions]]. The 2000 ''Shadows of the Empire'' mini-expansion is a different product from the 1996–97 full expansion cancelled in ''The Duelist'' #15.<ref name="duelist15news" />
